title: FX Brief — 09 Sep 2026
intro:
Yen surge continues as risk-off sentiment dominates Asian session, driving broad-based USD/JPY selling with 3.53% settlement decline extending safe-haven flows.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING

2. GBP +0.55% — Sterling resilience sustained by rate differential expectations
3. EUR +0.48% — Euro benefits from dollar weakness and stable eurozone data
4. CHF +0.55% — Safe-haven bid alongside yen supporting franc appreciation
5. CAD +0.53% — Loonie gains on oil price stability and broad USD retreat
6. NZD +0.14% — Kiwi lagging antipodean peers despite positive settlement
7. USD -0.089% — Dollar weakens across board as yen repatriation accelerates
8. JPY +3.53% — Strongest performer on unwinding carry trades and risk aversion
